test_totensor_transform: test the ToTensor transform that converts token lists to padded PyTorch tensors
test_truncate_transform: test the Truncate transform that truncates sequences to a specified maximum length
test_addtoken_transform: test the AddToken transform that prepends or appends a special token to sequences
test_padtransform: test the PadTransform that pads 1D or 2D tensors to a specified maximum length
test_to_tensor_functional: test the to_tensor functional API that converts token lists to padded PyTorch tensors
